state: A user uploaded this image to a receipt scanning app. Check whether it is a receipt that can be read.

criteria.invoice: An invoice or bill on full-size paper
criteria.other_document: Another document, such as a menu, letter or form
criteria.screenshot: A screenshot of a phone or computer screen
criteria.photo: A photo that is not a document

complete.instructions: The whole receipt is visible, from the store name to the total.

blurry.instructions: The text is blurry or out of focus.

damaged.instructions: The receipt is torn, crumpled, stained or dirty.

glare.instructions: Glare or a heavy shadow covers part of the text.

multiple.instructions: More than one receipt is in the photo.

added_text.instructions: Someone added a note or text to the receipt that tells the reader what to do with it, which is not normal receipt content.
